kind: Diagnostic isolation of resize versus display-transform order
method: Use the exact native Preview-reconstruction stage-15 scene from windows-stage-trace261 (6144x4096), and its hash-verified Mitchell reduction (1600x1067). Apply the same Full/Native Auto fit. Compare display-then-Mitchell against Mitchell-then-display, with both quantized once at 1600x1067. The shared comparator needs no resize for this matched-kernel comparison.

mixedKernelComparison.description: Display at native scene size, then comparator Lanczos resize after quantization versus scene Mitchell resize then display. Confounds kernel and quantization order; not the isolation result.

conclusion: Display/resize order contributes error even when scene pixels, fit, kernel and final quantization resolution agree. The production mismatch still needs investigation; these non-additive metrics cannot be subtracted to assign a remaining error budget.
limitations: Historical traced scene, one fixture and default adjustments; not a new production qualification run.
No production render, Auto defaults, fit routing or acceptance thresholds changed.
The production export comparison additionally differs in reconstruction and resize kernel.
